versions.content: If DET reporting is enabled via J1939RmDevErrorDetect, the J1939 Request Manager shall check node handle parameters of its API functions against the node handles o f J1939Nm referenced via J1939RmNmNodeRef, and shall report the development error J1939RM_E_INVALID_NODE_ID when an unknown handle is provided by the call.
